sources.translation: On the holy field of Kurukṣetra, assembled together, eager to fight...

sources.pdf: Marjayante mahā-bhāgā / bhīṣmaṁ ca droṇam ca mādhavam
sources.translation: O Sañjaya, after my sons and the sons of Pandu assembled...

sources.pdf: Śreyān svabhāvo guṇavān / tat sangas tu sadoṣavat
sources.translation: It is far better to discharge one's prescribed duty...

sources.pdf: Sarva-dharmān parityajya / mām ekaṁ śaraṇaṁ vraja
sources.translation: Abandon all varieties of religion and just surrender unto Me...
